why: Pipeline spec v1 (docs/shader.md#pipeline-spec, plans/m4.md M4.P06, M4.P07): the pack's colour targets as resources and one pass per program in frame order, under shader/shaders/ (the root the overworld's, world-1 the Nether's, world1 the End's); a forward program that also draws before deferred (the overlays' writers, the beacon beam's core, leashes: D76) is listed after deferred, where it draws its scene output. tests/test_pipeline.py keeps it equal to the pack: each resource's format and clear as the pack sets them at its defaults, history where a pass reads last frame's values (none yet); per pass its dimensions, the samplers and uniforms its two stages declare at the defaults over its folders, its outputs at the defaults (RENDERTARGETS; none for the shadow pass's empty DRAWBUFFERS), each option whose setting changes its preprocessed text (an include's unused function or the targets' comment counts), budget null until M4.P11's cost rows (D84), its views, defineOff, waiver and dimensionWaivers from M4.P08's captures (viewsWhy).
cycleWhy: BENCH_DETERMINISTIC's cycle in frames: the pack reads no term that moves from frame to frame, so a frame repeats every frame (docs/shader.md#determinism-and-taa).
viewsWhy: M4.P08's coverage list (docs/shader.md#coverage-list, plans/m4.md D83): a pass's views are those of the views file (perf, then coverage) whose capture of the pack at its defaults draws a label Iris resolves to its program (m4-coverage-capture-1 on the 11 perf views, m4-coverage-capture-2 on the four coverage views, rain, forest_noon, nether_crimson and end_dragon; tests/fixtures/l4/coverage.json); defineOff those where only its BENCH_DETERMINISTIC-off capture draws it (capture-2's eight views); a pass no view draws carries a waiver, its reason, else none; dimensionWaivers gives the reason for each dimension of a drawn pass none of whose views draws it. A pass the define discards (particles, particles_translucent, clouds: shader.md#determinism-and-taa) still draws there, its fragments discarded: its look is the define-off captures'. Particles alive at a view vary by launch (rain's particles_translucent in capture-2 alone); the views are the captures' union.

resources.name: scene
resources.why: the HDR scene (plans/m4.md D78): deferred writes every pixel, the forward programs blend over it after; never cleared, as deferred covers it

resources.name: gbuffer
resources.why: the G-buffer's 64 bits (D75, lib/gbuffer.glsl): every opaque draw writes it whole, blending bypassed; never cleared, as Iris's float clear is undefined on it (P14), so deferred reads it only where depth shows geometry

resources.name: early
resources.why: the sun and moon (skytextured), which deferred adds at the sky's pixels, and under LIGHT_PATH 0 the opaque surfaces lit in their own programs; cleared to 0

resources.name: mod
resources.why: D76's multiplied overlay (crumbling, M4.P07), applied to the albedo before lighting; cleared to white

resources.name: emit
resources.why: D76's added overlay (the shield and trim glint pass, M4.P07), added after lighting; cleared to 0

resources.name: trans
resources.why: D76's premultiplied overlay (banner patterns, armour cracks, M4.P07), put over the lit scene; cleared to 0

resources.name: display
resources.why: the tonemapped, sRGB-encoded frame final dithers onto the screen; never cleared, as composite covers it
